opeid college code: unique OPEID identifier for the institution
overall graduation rate: percentage of entering students who graduate
address: street address, city, state and ZIP code
percent of students receiving financial: percentage of students who receive any financial aid
highest degree offered: highest academic degree the university awards
institution type: public or private classification and level (e.g., 4‑Year or Above)
local area: size classification of the surrounding community
college alias: alternative names or abbreviations for the university
professional enrollment: number of professional program students enrolled
